methodology.scope: Compact JSON.stringify(events) UTF-8 arrays only; recording envelope, outcomes, transport and headers excluded.
methodology.compression: All variants use identical gzip level 9 and Brotli quality 11 text-mode settings.
methodology.no_cursor_definition: Remove only IncrementalSnapshot type 3 with source 1, 2, 6 or 12; retain DOM mutations, inputs, scroll and resize.
methodology.caveat: Source 2 includes Focus and Blur as well as pointer clicks. This removes pointer/interaction events, not merely the visible cursor.
methodology.final_state: Fresh Meta + FullSnapshot supplied by caller, not the original initial snapshot; no history is preserved.

warnings: One session is illustrative; duration, movement sampling, DOM changes, images and interaction frequency affect the result.
Hiding the replay cursor or mouse tail does not reduce stored event bytes.
Filtering one recording makes content/actions/timing identical; it measures payload savings, not recorder CPU savings.
Preserve all prerequisite mutations when producing a final state; simply taking the last incremental event cannot recreate the view.
